statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal O_0$ a surjection of sheaves of rings with square-zero kernel $\mathcal I$. Write $D^-(\mathcal O)$ for the derived category of complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules with bounded-above cohomology, and $D^-(\mathcal O_0)$ analogously. A derived lift of $K_0\in D^-(\mathcal O_0)$ is $K\in D^-(\mathcal O)$ with a specified isomorphism $K\otimes_\mathcal O^{\mathbf L}\mathcal O_0\cong K_0$. An Ext group $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal O_0}(K,L)$ means $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_0)}(K,L[n])$.

Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $\mathcal{O} \to \mathcal{O}_0$
be a surjection of sheaves of rings whose kernel is an ideal sheaf
$\mathcal{I}$ of square zero. For every object
$K_0$ in $D^-(\mathcal{O}_0)$ there is a canonical map
$$
\omega(K_0) :
K_0 \longrightarrow
K_0 \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_0}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{I}[2]
$$
in $D(\mathcal{O}_0)$ such that for any map
$K_0 \to L_0$ in $D^-(\mathcal{O}_0)$ the diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
K_0 \ar[d] \ar[rr]_-{\omega(K_0)} & &
(K_0 \otimes^\mathbf{L}_{\mathcal{O}_0} \mathcal{I})[2] \ar[d] \\
L_0 \ar[rr]^-{\omega(L_0)} & &
(L_0 \otimes^\mathbf{L}_{\mathcal{O}_0} \mathcal{I})[2]
}
$$
commutes.

statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal O_0$ a surjection of sheaves of rings with square-zero kernel $\mathcal I$. Write $D^-(\mathcal O)$ for the derived category of complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules with bounded-above cohomology, and $D^-(\mathcal O_0)$ analogously. A derived lift of $K_0\in D^-(\mathcal O_0)$ is $K\in D^-(\mathcal O)$ with a specified isomorphism $K\otimes_\mathcal O^{\mathbf L}\mathcal O_0\cong K_0$. Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $\mathcal{O} \to \mathcal{O}_0$
be a surjection of sheaves of rings whose kernel is an ideal sheaf
$\mathcal{I}$ of square zero. Let $K, L \in D^-(\mathcal{O})$.
Set $K_0 = K \otimes_\mathcal{O}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{O}_0$
and $L_0 = L \otimes_\mathcal{O}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{O}_0$
in $D^-(\mathcal{O}_0)$. Given $\alpha_0 : K_0 \to L_0$ in $D(\mathcal{O}_0)$
there is a canonical element
$$
o(\alpha_0) \in \operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal{O}_0}(K_0,
L_0 \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_0}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{I})
$$
whose vanishing is necessary and sufficient for the
existence of a map $\alpha : K \to L$ in $D(\mathcal{O})$
with $\alpha_0 = \alpha \otimes_\mathcal{O}^\mathbf{L} \text{id}$.

\label{lemma-inf-obs-map-defo-complex}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site. Let $\mathcal{O} \to \mathcal{O}_0$
be a surjection of sheaves of rings whose kernel is an ideal sheaf
$\mathcal{I}$ of square zero. Let $K, L \in D^-(\mathcal{O})$.
Set $K_0 = K \otimes_\mathcal{O}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{O}_0$
and $L_0 = L \otimes_\mathcal{O}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{O}_0$
in $D^-(\mathcal{O}_0)$. Given $\alpha_0 : K_0 \to L_0$ in $D(\mathcal{O}_0)$
there is a canonical element
$$
o(\alpha_0) \in \Ext^1_{\mathcal{O}_0}(K_0,
L_0 \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_0}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{I})
$$
whose vanishing is necessary and sufficient for the
existence of a map $\alpha : K \to L$ in $D(\mathcal{O})$
with $\alpha_0 = \alpha \otimes_\mathcal{O}^\mathbf{L} \text{id}$.
